LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAIncense.label: PNA incense application
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAIncense.description: Discover how heating humpshroom mixed into PNA produces mist. Unlocks the non-electric censer.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAElectricMist.label: precision electrothermal mist
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAElectricMist.description: Control electric heat to adjust mist coverage. Unlocks an electric aphrodisiac atomizer that uses less humpshroom at the same radius, and a PNA mist emitter that uses ordinary PNA and has low and high settings.
